__note__: tabelog.syncBase as written by the 2026-07-28 sync-versioning release: the common ancestor for the three-way merge that runs when a PUT comes back 409. Boot must not clear it — without the base, a conflict degrades to last-writer-wins and one device's additions are lost. Paired here with a matching state cache so it looks like a real signed-in-then-signed-out device.
